verses.english: “Mendicants, you should associate with a friend who has three factors.

verses.pali: Duddadaṁ dadāti, dukkaraṁ karoti, dukkhamaṁ khamati—
verses.english: They give what is hard to give, they do what is hard to do, and they bear what is hard to bear.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi aṅgehi samannāgato mitto sevitabbo”ti.
verses.english: You should associate with a friend who has these three factors.”
